lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the torso mass; spacing is approximately equidistant with a slight increase in density toward the posterior third of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most vertical markings terminate mid-torso, transitioning from continuous lines into abbreviated segments and distinct spots before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-6 distinct white spots localized on the lateral haunch and the upper section of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper haunch align horizontally, forming a short geometric segment parallel to the dorsal line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal marking visible on the lower interior of the forelimb and a white chevron-like patch visible on the facial bridge.
